Cheers for replying Joe - where would I put the statement, eg. in your output example if I'm trying something like: 

library(shiny)

source("linechart.R")

shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    # addResourcePath('www', 'www'),
    tags$h2("JavaScript output binding example"),
    fluidRow(
      column(width=6,
             p("This Shiny app is an adaptation of the",
               a(href="http://nvd3.org/examples/line.html", "Simple Line Chart"),
               "example for the",
               a(href="http://nvd3.org/", "NVD3.js"),
               "JavaScript charting library."
             ),
             p("Source code:",
               a(href="https://github.com/jcheng5/shiny-js-examples/tree/master/output", "@jcheng5/shiny-js-examples/output"))
      )
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(width=9,
             lineChartOutput("mychart")
      ),
      column(width=3,
             sliderInput("sinePhase", "Sine phase", -180, 180, 0, step=10,
                         animate=animationOptions(interval=100, loop=TRUE)),
             sliderInput("sineAmplitude", "Sine amplitude", -2, 2, 1, step=0.1,
                         animate=animationOptions(interval=100, loop=TRUE))
      )
    )
  ), 
  server = function(input, output, session) {
    
    output$mychart <- renderLineChart({
      # Return a data frame. Each column will be a series in the line chart.
      data.frame(
        Sine = sin(1:100/10 + input$sinePhase * pi/180) * input$sineAmplitude,
        Cosine = 0.5 * cos(1:100/10),
        "Sine 2" = sin(1:100/10) * 0.25 + 0.5
      )
    })
  }
)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shinyApp www folder js/html/css
parts:
(Sorry for the terseness, I'm attending a class)

You need to make sure addResourcePath has been called before a browser requests those JS/CSS/image resources. There's no reason to assume this would be before the server function runs, and in fact I'd assume on a fresh R process that would probably not work. I'd assume the order is something like 1) web page requested, 2) JS/CSS/image requested, 3) connection to server established. You're probably seeing it work because addResourcePath only needs to be called once per R process--its effects last until that process ends.

    )
  ), 
  server = function(input, output, session) {
    
    output$mychart <- renderLineChart({
      # Return a data frame. Each column will be a series in the line chart.
      data.frame(
        Sine = sin(1:100/10 + input$sinePhase * pi/180) * input$sineAmplitude,
        Cosine = 0.5 * cos(1:100/10),
        "Sine 2" = sin(1:100/10) * 0.25 + 0.5
      )
    })
  }
)
